test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 17th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Enthusiasm
solution:
The correct answer is **Lethargy.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Enthusiasm** means a strong feeling of excitement or interest in something and a desire to become involved in it.

 ** -Example:** Karan showed great enthusiasm for the new project.

 
• Marked option **Lethargy** means the feeling of being very tired and not having any energy.

 ** -Example:** I was feeling tired and lethargic.

So, it is clear that **Enthusiasm** and** Lethargy** are opposite in meaning.

​Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Excitement** means the state of being excited, especially because something interesting is happening or will happen.
 
• **Passion** means a very strong feeling, especially of love, hate or anger.
 
• **Devotion** means great love for somebody/something.
